key_headlines.title: South Korea's May Exports Surge 64.8% as Consumer Sentiment Rebounds
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul announced that May exports through the 20th increased 64.8% year-over-year, while consumer sentiment rebounded for the first time in three months amid stable management of Middle East war uncertainties.

key_headlines.title: Government Expands 'Everyone's Startup' Program to 10,000 Participants
key_headlines.summary: The government expanded the second round of the 'Everyone's Startup' initiative to 10,000 people after 63,000 applicants in the first round, providing mentoring and 4 million won in support to selected entrepreneurs.

key_headlines.title: Moody's Raises South Korea's 2026 GDP Growth Forecast to 2.9%
key_headlines.summary: Credit rating agency Moody's upgraded South Korea's GDP growth forecast from 2.6% to 2.9% for 2026, citing strong semiconductor momentum as a key driver of economic expansion.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment and Villa Monthly Rent Prices Hit Record Highs
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment and villa monthly rental price indices reached all-time highs as renters shift from jeonse (long-term lease) to monthly rentals due to supply shortages, increasing housing burden for tenants.

key_headlines.title: Kevin Wash Takes Office as New Federal Reserve Chair
key_headlines.summary: Kevin Wash officially became the 11th Federal Reserve chairman, with his first FOMC meeting scheduled for mid-June, as markets debate potential interest rate hikes amid persistent inflation concerns.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic momentum strengthened in May with exports surging 64.8% and consumer sentiment rebounding for the first time in three months, signaling economic recovery despite lingering Middle East war uncertainties. The government is accelerating its startup initiative with the 'Everyone's Startup' program expanded to 10,000 participants, providing comprehensive support including mentoring and funding. Meanwhile, the government is shifting to a preventive approach for personal information protection by implementing risk-differentiated management strategies across high, medium, and low-risk sectors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Moody's upgraded South Korea's 2026 GDP growth forecast to 2.9% from 2.6%, crediting strong semiconductor exports as the primary growth driver. South Korea's first-quarter GDP growth of 1.694% significantly exceeded market expectations of 0.8%, demonstrating robust economic performance. Tax expenditures are projected to exceed 80 trillion won this year—a record high—requiring government oversight to prevent fiscal waste, with over 70% of expiring programs scheduled for termination or restructuring. Japan's April consumer prices rose 1.4% as energy subsidies contained inflation, though real wages continue declining for a fourth consecutive year.
sections.Financial Markets: US equity markets rose for a second consecutive day with the Dow Jones index gaining 0.6% as US-Iran diplomatic negotiations progress and bond yields decline. The US Federal Reserve's April meeting minutes reveal multiple officials support considering further rate hikes, keeping market expectations of additional increases alive. South Korea's KOSPI rose 0.41% while KOSDAQ surged nearly 5% on expectations from the National Growth Fund, with the won-dollar exchange rate climbing to 1517.2 won. Rising bond yields are attracting investor attention to bond-type ETFs despite concerns about further rate increases.
sections.Industry & Technology: Lotte Energy Materials is divesting its Lotte Ecowall division to accelerate investment in high-value AI infrastructure products including circuit boards for AI data centers, ultra-thin semiconductor materials, and battery foils for energy storage devices. Hanwool Semiconductor is advancing AI-based inspection solutions for multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC) to meet surging demand from expanding AI server and robot markets, supplying equipment to global leaders. Samsung Electronics' junior labor union strike announcement has triggered significant national attention, with the government considering emergency mediation measures. The EU is exploring temporary sanctions exemptions for Chinese chip supplier Yangzhou Yangjie Electronics to stabilize automotive supply chains.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment and villa monthly rental price indices hit all-time highs as the shortage of jeonse (long-term lease) properties forces tenants toward monthly rentals, significantly increasing housing costs for renters. Seoul apartment prices recorded their largest weekly gain in 16 weeks at 0.31%, with mid-to-low-priced areas in Seodaemun-gu showing particularly strong growth as the market restructures around actual owner-occupiers. Co-living residential spaces are rapidly expanding in Seoul with investment doubling year-over-year, offering shared facilities like kitchens and lounges alongside private bedrooms to attract single-person households. Real estate experts note that despite population decline forecasts, Seoul housing prices remain resilient due to concentrated income growth in the capital region.
sections.International Economy: New Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Wash officially took office with his first FOMC meeting scheduled for mid-June, as markets assess potential interest rate hike scenarios following a hawkish April meeting. The Fed's April FOMC minutes reveal widespread sentiment among officials that additional rate increases should be considered, with market pricing showing a 51.1% probability of a rate hike by December. Global stock markets continue tracking US inflation data, with upcoming April PCE price index release on May 29th seen as crucial for determining Fed policy direction. The Trump administration has emphasized the Fed's independence while markets debate whether interest rate increases are imminent.
sections.AI & Economy: Hyundai Steel is aggressively entering the AI power infrastructure market with a comprehensive package strategy, supplying steel materials for data center frameworks, internal components, and equipment as the nation's only producer capable of covering the entire supply chain. Hancom is partnering with LG AI Research to integrate its AI agent technology into the ChatExaWon platform, advancing both public and private sector AI market penetration. Global tech giants including Google, Amazon, and Meta face bubble concerns regarding massive AI data center capital investments, though analysts suggest return prospects remain viable with annual costs around $8.5 billion per gigawatt facility. The National Growth Fund is gaining popularity with government emphasis on protecting labor rights amid AI-driven productivity gains and economic transformation.
sections.Others: The United States is implementing safety nets to address AI-driven job displacement, with California Governor Gavin Newsom taking direct action to counter employment impacts, signaling political priority around AI employment transitions. US-Iran war termination negotiations are accelerating with Pakistani and Qatari officials reportedly holding simultaneous meetings in Tehran to finalize peace agreement drafts. The Financial Supervisory Service is strengthening internal control requirements for asset management companies ahead of July fiduciary duty implementation, emphasizing compliance in derivatives transactions and fund management. The Trump administration is intensifying pressure on Cuba by prosecuting former President Raul Castro and revoking residency of military enterprise officials to cut off funding to the communist regime.
